The much awaited PRIYA PRIYA is here
Starring - Mahaveer Abhimanyu & Divya Kandukuri, Priya Priya is an upbeat number which takes us on a foot tapping journey around New York City. Get ready for a whirlwind love story filled with adorable meet-cutes & big dreams in the city!
Story & Directed by Poojitha Varma & Charan Rekula
Music - The Fantasia Men
Produced by - Anil Kumar & Poojitha Varma
Musicians Credits
Composed, Arranged and Programmed by - THE FANTASIA MEN
Flute - Yedhu
